arguments.summary: Captured the quotation preparation process: (1) Sales employee receives and logs the customer's quotation request (system unknown; DONT_KNOW). (2) Sales employee checks customer information in the CRM (rationale unknown). (3) Sales employee creates the quotation document in the quoting system, reading customer information and pricing information (quotation request details usage unknown); rationale unknown. (4) Branch: if amount > 1,000,000 yen, manager approves the quotation (rationale: credit risk management; whether approval records anything and whether rejection is possible: DONT_KNOW), then the sales employee sends the quotation to the customer via email; if amount ≤ 1,000,000 yen, it goes straight to the customer. Whether anything happens after sending is unknown. Separately, at the end of each month, the sales employee sends the month-end summary of quotation information to Accounting via Excel (source of summary information unknown). Rationales for most steps remain unknown per the stakeholder.
